keshome_lowther.text: Welcome! A Pipkin sits on our windowsill every morning, waistcoat out, demanding crumbs. We pay in toast.
Our daughter is in the school play at Theatre by the Lake. It opened on the lakeshore in 1999. We have heard every line forty times.

keshome_lowther_kid.text: I am a tree. It is a speaking part. I say 'whoosh'.
Dad says I am the best tree he has ever seen. He has seen one other tree.

then.text: Back for the Cumberland Sausage? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: A proper Cumberland comes in a coil. Not links. If you cut it up, I'll know.
Prick it and pan it whole, slowly. Mash and onion gravy underneath. Whatever you do, don't twist it into links.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
